decision: Determine whether the D1Q2 LBM scheme for shallow water equations in TensorLBM achieves <15% error vs analytical/FV reference solutions.
hypothesis: The D1Q2 BGK LBM scheme will match the FV Rusanov solver within 15% for smooth wave propagation, but may struggle with shock/dry-bed problems.
stopping_rule: Run all resolutions (200, 400, 800) for both test cases. If LBM becomes unstable (NaN/Inf), record as known limitation.

smooth_wave.description: Small-amplitude Gaussian perturbation on constant depth

dam_break.description: Ritter dam-break with dry bed downstream
